title: The moribund Highway
physical_identity: Roadside desert patch with a perfectly straight highway; vehicles frozen mid-movement between lanes under a pale afternoon sun.
scale_topology: Outdoor, stretching 'far and wide'; one straight highway; size not stated.
anomalies: hearing only your own hearing inside vehicles
lighting_sound: Afternoon sun over pale desert; stillness; inside vehicles only own hearing audible.

entrances.quote: a one-way threshold of clumped cells

exits.method: most folks cross; deciding on the verge

signature_mechanic: A still, one-way highway of frozen cars; vehicles may unlock to reveal interrupted lives and a hearing-only soundscape.
conflicts_notes: No class, entrance, exit, entity or hazard sections; the 'one-way threshold' wording is the only access hint. Dialogue and vignette are poetic and unreliable. Links to Levels 49 and 51 lack context.

key_quotes.quote: A moribund patch of roadside desert, stretching far and wide
vehicles standing mid-movement; caught between lanes
these vehicles may unlock, should moribund permits
You stand on it waitin' for the conqueror worm.
Nothin' stays the same 'round these parts.
